title: Correctness of the multiplication state
statement: Let $\ell>0$, let $m,x,y\in\mathbb{F}_2^\ell$, and set $f_m(X)=X^\ell+\sum_{i=0}^{\ell-1}m_iX^i$ and $\alpha=X$ in the quotient $\mathbb{F}_2[X]/(f_m)$. For each vector $v$, write $E(v)=\sum_{i=0}^{\ell-1}v_i\alpha^i$, and put $P_r(y)=\sum_{i=0}^{r-1}y_i\alpha^i$, with $y_i=0$ for $i\ge\ell$. If the multiplication state at step $r$ is $(u_r,v_r)$, then $E(u_r)=E(x)P_r(y)$ and $E(v_r)=\alpha^rE(x)$.
